name: body-rotation
summary: Count a person's turns about the vertical axis and each jump's airtime and turns (figure skating, diving, gymnastics, dance). Experimental.

hardware.camera: a fixed camera that keeps the whole body in view; a turn shows two shoulder-line sign changes, so the frame rate must exceed 4 x the fastest turns per second
hardware.compute: one pose model in its own environment

sota.summary: RTMW-l whole-body pose (COCO-WholeBody 70.1 AP), MediaPipe full when it cannot keep up (#373 rule)

ultralytics.summary: Ultralytics' combination: YOLO26-pose (17 COCO points), like its AIGym rep counting by joint angles

limits: experimental: checked on synthetic joints only; the direction of a turn is not told from 2D joints; a turn seen from above or a somersault (about a horizontal axis) is not counted
